stdout:
Upload a channel banner. Use this tool to upload a channel banner.

Usage:
  yutu channelBanner insert [flags]

Examples:
# Upload a channel banner
yutu channelBanner insert --channelId UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw --file banner.jpg
# Upload a channel banner with JSON output
yutu channelBanner insert --channelId UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw --file banner.png --output json

Flags:
  -c, --channelId string                       ID of the channel to insert the banner for
  -f, --file string                            Path to the banner image
  -h, --help                                   help for insert
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string          ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwnerChannel string   YouTube channel ID linked to the content owner
  -o, --output string                          json|yaml|silent
      --yes                                    Confirm the operation
